detail: No legal timber harvesting landbase boundary is used. Tenure is a rights footprint, not a harvest-landbase determination.
effect: All areas are screening proxies and must not be labelled THLB or AAC.

detail: No national DEM is present in the workspace, so no slope, elevation, operability, or site-degradation filter is applied.
effect: Steep and inoperable terrain remains in every v2 area.

detail: The NBAC bundle is the 2020 annual vintage (YEAR=2020 for all 710 polygons). It contains no 2010 or 2015 fire history, so those sensitivity screens cannot be computed from this input.
effect: Only a 2020 fire screen is reported; the 2010 and 2015 cases are explicit gaps, not zero-disturbance assumptions.

detail: NBAC polygons are annual fire perimeters with YEAR/NFIREID and polygon attributes. They are not a cumulative severity or burn-class stack, so no cumulative class is interpreted.
effect: The disturbance screen is an annual 2020 burned/not-burned mask.

detail: All 13 NRN province bundles were materialised and used. NRN is the public road network; resource, industrial, winter, and decommissioned roads are not represented, and road condition/seasonality is absent.
effect: Road distance is an optimistic public-road access proxy.

detail: SCANFI median age is a stand-age prediction. Excluding stands below 20 or 30 years assumes they are not merchantable at the screen date, which is stricter than the v1 height/biomass/closure thresholds and ignores partial harvest, thinning, and regeneration delay.
effect: Age screens reduce area beyond merchantability alone.

detail: The v1 managed share is uniform inside each province-ecoprovince. Tenure was not re-intersected with the age, burn, or road rasters.
effect: Spatial tenure pattern is not represented.

detail: SCANFI age is a 30 m prediction surface, not a provincial inventory or a time-since-disturbance record.
effect: Age thresholds are screening conventions, not statutory rules.
